track: Track 02: The Agent That Can Explain Why
summary: Agent team that answers student registration questions from the university catalog, schedule, programs and policies, with every reason linked to its source and unsettled questions escalated to an advisor.

sponsor_tech.zetaris: Data layer: four separate REST sources registered as Lightning REST tables in the pathcheck Lightning database; all agent SQL runs through the Zetaris REST API (pathcheck/data.py, zetaris/register.sql).
sponsor_tech.meterless_nightshift: Primary AI provider via the Meterless provider contract (pathcheck/llm.py); fast, deep and judge lanes.
sponsor_tech.nvidia: Nemotron models served through Nightshift; model id recorded per agent request in logs and results.
sponsor_tech.cursor: Not used; built with Claude Code.

pre_existing: WSU public catalog/schedule/policy snapshot crawled before 22 Oct 2026 (data/)
